info.name: ServeRest API Tests — QA 5X Challenge
info.description:
## ServeRest API Test Suite

Automated API test collection for the [ServeRest](https://serverest.dev) virtual store API.

### Coverage

| Suite | Scenarios |
| --- | --- |
| Auth | Login success, invalid credentials, missing fields |
| Users | CRUD full lifecycle, duplicate email, delete |
| Products | CRUD full lifecycle, duplicate name |
| 🛒 Cart | Create, duplicate block, checkout, cancel |

### How to run

1. Import this collection and the `ServeRest_ENV.postman_environment.json` environment.
    
2. Select the **ServeRest ENV** environment.
    
3. Click **Run collection** (Collection Runner).
    
4. All environment variables are set automatically via pre-request and test scripts.
    

### Base URL

`https://serverest.dev`
